import asyncio
from fastmcp import FastMCP
from fastmcp.client import AsyncClientSession


async def main():
    # Create server instance
    server = FastMCP(name="example-server")
    
    # Register resource handler
    @server.resource("data://config")
    def get_config():
        return "configuration data here"
    
    # Create in-memory client session connected to server
    async with AsyncClientSession(server._handler) as client:
        # Fetch resource contents
        resource = await client.read_resource("data://config")
        print(f"Resource contents: {resource.contents}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
